children: On August 27, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that its stock failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) for 30 consecutive business days. The company has 180 days, until Feb 23, 2027, to regain compliance by achieving a closing bid of at least $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days, with a possible additional 180-day extension; trading continues on Nasdaq during this period.
